user_theory: We already turned the genius thinking way into weights (v1-v3 PBCS artifacts: skeleton classifier, role priors, op log-ratio bands, per-multiset answer bands, order prior, word->constant table). Since we already hold those weights, the next WSPL step is to TRAIN THEM: fine-tune the compiled genius weight artifacts directly, in weight space, staying with our goal of directly working with weights instead of using ML. Measure what fine-tuning the genius weights buys on the oracle-vs-selected gap this time.

wspl_ladder.v1: genius reasoning chains compiled into priors (making)
wspl_ladder.v2: Genius-RAM: 4 genius weight artifacts + memory pull
wspl_ladder.v3: NCM-PBCS: parallel coarse-to-fine generation, oracle 39.95% but selector 1.44% (selection wall found)
wspl_ladder.v4: fine-tuning compiled into a 13-feature IRLS selector head (3.18% strict, 2.21x v3, ~8% of oracle realized)
wspl_ladder.v5: THIS RUN: fine-tune the genius weight artifacts themselves (FT-A/B/C closed-form weight-space updates), NCM generation kept, v4 head protocol refitted on regenerated candidates

genius_ft_spec.no_gradient: every update is closed-form (weighted ridge, weighted counts, weighted quantiles) - fine-tuning as direct weight replacement; no backprop, no optimizer loop
genius_ft_spec.signal: leak-free generative-correctness from the v3-identical LOO pipeline on the 1000 mined train items: per item, tried multisets (candidate skeleton multisets actually generated) and delivered multisets/orders (those through which a valid candidate equal to gold was produced)
genius_ft_spec.classifier_lambda_note: frozen = v3's selected lambda (baselines.v3_head_compile.lambda), not re-tuned
genius_ft_spec.FT_A_skeleton_weights: classifier refit W' = argmin sum_k d_k (y_k - x_k W)^2 + lambda||W||^2 with d_k = 1 + kappa*rel(ms_k), rel(m) = (delivered_m + 1)/(tried_m + 2) (Laplace-smoothed per-multiset delivery reliability); order prior updated: mining counts + kappa*delivered-order counts
genius_ft_spec.FT_B_operand_weights: role (operand-kind/position) counts and per-op operand log-ratio bands [q10,q90] re-fit with row weights d_k (weighted quantiles)
genius_ft_spec.FT_C_value_weights: per-multiset answer bands re-anchored to golds of train items that DELIVERED through that multiset (requires n_delivered >= 5, else keep v3 band); word->constant table counts reweighted by d_r with the unchanged v3 rule (top mass >= 2 and >= 0.25 of total weighted mass)
genius_ft_spec.loo_discipline: every LOO pack excludes the item's own mining row AND its own delivery/tried events (rel' recomputed per item); non-mined items exclude only their delivery events
genius_ft_spec.head: v4 protocol byte-identical: 13 features + bias recomputed under the fine-tuned artifacts, IRLS closed-form Newton, lambda grid [0.01,0.1,1,10,100] selected on 200-item val split (seed 20261124, 800/200)

arms.S2_v5_ft_f1only: same artifacts, score-only (f1+bias) head - HLE transfer arm
arms.S3_v5_fused: S1 head rank-fused 50/50 with v3 consensus score
arms.secondary_if_wall: ablations A-only, C-only, B-only (GSM only, each with own LOO head refit)

generation_frozen: NCM-PBCS one-pass generation byte-identical to v3/v4 (parallel skeleton concepts -> orderings -> genius+memory scored groundings -> one-pass candidates); only the weight artifacts underneath change
integrity_gates: GATE-1: signal pass must reproduce v4's LOO train records bit-exactly (cands arrays + ok_strict/ok_loose/oracle/consensus) on the first 25 items; any mismatch aborts before any FT artifact is built

GATE-2: v3-control for test = v4 state_test records (v3-identical generation, live bit-reproducibility verified after v4); recomputed control strict/loose must equal v3 reported exactly (< 1e-12) before any v5 number is reported
GATE-3: all FT artifacts order-deterministic (sorted keys); artifact disclosure file with rel table + change counts saved before test generation
GATE-4: per-stage timers recorded; any timer recording 0.0 is annotated (v3 lesson)
GATE-5: wall budget 460s foreground slices, checkpoint/resume via state files, no background processes
designed_risks_preregistered: delivery-reliability feedback could reduce skeleton diversity and LOWER oracle (measured, not assumed)
delivered-anchored bands could overfit the thin correctness signal (mitigated: n_delivered >= 5 floor with keep-v3 fallback)
HLE zero-shot transfer of the 13-feature head failed in v4; S2 (score-only) is the preregistered transfer arm

success_criteria_frozen.primary_gsm8k_full_strict: on the best preregistered arm (S1/S2/S3): PASS if acc >= 0.040; PARTIAL if > 0.031842 (v4 strict); HONEST NEGATIVE if <= 0.031842; any upgrade claim additionally requires beating v4
success_criteria_frozen.generation_check: S1 oracle_full_inline vs v4 0.399545: improved if >= 0.419545 (+2pp), degraded if <= 0.379545 (-2pp), else report as unchanged
success_criteria_frozen.secondary_hle_t2full: report vs v4 (full-head 0.010490, f1-only 0.020979); transfer improved if S2 > 0.020979; HLE-v1 report only
success_criteria_frozen.reporting_rule: whichever outcome occurs, real numbers reported; no post-hoc criterion changes

data: GSM8K train: 1000 preregistered mined indices (scripts/realbench/prereg.json, unchanged); GSM8K test full 1319; HLE T2-full 572 int items of 2370 pool; HLE v1 T2 56; embeddings frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, no gradients anywhere
